URL debug parameter vocabulary. ?debug=<value> may appear

UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

KEY

The query-string key — ?debug=….

NOTIFICATION_TEST

Fires a test toast notification at boot (notification pipeline check).

WEBGL_MODE

webGLMode:<mode> forces the WebGL pipeline — active (default probing) or fallback (every context acquisition returns null, so all widgets render their CSS/2D fallback).

WEBGPU_WIDGETS

webgpuWidgets:<mode> gates the WebGPU widget layer — active opts in; absent/fallback keeps every widget on its WebGL/CSS path. The layer mounts by default once the worker route is verified on real hardware; until then it is opt-in.

WEBGL_MODES

webGLMode: values.
